article.title: Brazil’s election is a referendum on Israel, and the last hurdle for Latin America’s pro-Israel right
article.author: Ana Maria Monjardino
article.content: Brazil’s Oct. 25 presidential runoff is a referendum on Israel and the final test of Latin America’s rightward swing, with Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro offering starkly different paths for Palestine.
source_folders: 06_左派ニュース・社会主義戦略
